messages:
sasha: quick RFC follow-up on lease model. need to pick final behavior for release semantics and NUMA hinting.
ran: ok. shortlist?
sasha: fast-release (O(1) path + async reclaim) vs sync-release; and whether NUMA is soft hint or enforced.
maria: prefer fast-release. release should enqueue descriptor and return. sync scans blow tail latency.
devon: implementation: release -> mark(RELEASED) -> push to per-tenant ring -> return. reclaimer drains rings with budget. keep release <200ns.
kevin: NUMA should be advisory. customers will misuse strict NUMA. flags: SOFT_NUMA_LOCALITY, HIGH_RETENTION; runtime may ignore.
ran: how do we handle slab coalescing order?
maria: propose compactness_score = (free_bytes / slab_size) + age_factor - tenant_priority_weight. higher score -> reclaim earlier. keep formula linear and tunable.
devon: add per-tenant backlog multiplier so noisy tenants don't starve others.
sasha: cross-tenant sharing? default soft-sharing with quotas; enterprise opt-in for strict islandization.
kevin: migration: include lease_epoch in handle. moving increments epoch and emits MOVE_EVENT. old handles accepted during grace_window, then return ESTALE.
devon: stale handles: allow reads until refcount==0; writes/new-allocs fail fast.
ran: metrics ops needs: tenant_resident_bytes, lease_queue_len, reclaim_throughput, reclaim_latency_p50/p95, reclaim_backpressure_gauge.
maria: test plan: microbench for release path (<200ns), forced-queue reclaim, tenant-move during reclaim, deterministic coalesce test.
devon: I'll add fuzz harness in runtime tests.
ops-bot: CI report: lease-rework branch unit tests passed (CI #4021) :white_check_mark:
sasha: action items: update RFC with API snippet and advisory flag docs; maria/devon draft compactness pseudo-code; kevin/ops list thresholds. reconvene EOD tomorrow.
ran: ack.
maria: starting compactness doc now.
